{"inp":{"code":"# Calculations for PETR4 pricing based on provided row 209 data
# Provided data (row 209):
VPA = 28.397361
LPA = 2.840155
EBIT = 2.103970e11  # 210,397,000,000
NetDebt = 3.268160e11  # 326,816,000,000
Patrimonio = 3.660060e11  # 366,006,000,000
price = 31.08

# Estimate shares outstanding from VPA = Patrimonio / shares => shares = Patrimonio / VPA
shares = Patrimonio / VPA

# P/B target 1.6x
pb_target = 1.6 * VPA

# EV/EBIT target 3.0x -> EV = 3*EBIT -> implied Equity = EV - NetDebt -> price = Equity/shares
ev = 3.0 * EBIT
equity_from_ev = ev - NetDebt
price_from_ev = equity_from_ev / shares

# P/E target 4.5x applied to LPA
pe_target = 4.5 * LPA

shares, pb_target, price_from_ev, pe_target
print(f"estimated_shares_outstanding = {shares:.0f}")
print(f"P/B target price (1.6x VPA) = {pb_target:.2f}")
print(f"EV/EBIT implied price (3x) = {price_from_ev:.2f}")
print(f"P/E target price (4.5x LPA) = {pe_target:.2f}")

# Compute blended target using weights 60% P/B + 40% EV/EBIT
blend_60_40 = 0.6*pb_target + 0.4*price_from_ev
# Also compute earlier blends e.g., 45% P/E + 45% P/B + 10% EV/EBIT
blend_45_45_10 = 0.45*pe_target + 0.45*pb_target + 0.10*price_from_ev

print(f"Blend 60% P/B + 40% EV/EBIT = {blend_60_40:.2f}")
print(f"Blend 45% P/E + 45% P/B + 10% EV/EBIT = {blend_45_45_10:.2f}")

# Also compute simple average of PB and EV prices
simple_avg = (pb_target + price_from_ev)/2
print(f"Simple average (PB, EV) = {simple_avg:.2f}")

# Upside from current price
print(f"Current price = {price}")
print(f"Upside vs current for blend60/40 = {(blend_60_40/price-1)*100:.1f}%")
print(f"Upside vs current for blend45/45/10 = {(blend_45_45_10/price-1)*100:.1f}%")
print(f"Upside vs current for PB target = {(pb_target/price-1)*100:.1f}%")
print(f"Upside vs current for EV implied price = {(price_from_ev/price-1)*100:.1f}%")
"} }
